subject.title: Telegram: unquarantine skipped sticker e2e tests

question: Should the Telegram suite still restore the static WEBP sticker metadata e2e test, or is the current runtime/docs coverage plus cache-refresh e2e test sufficient?
rationale: Current main only partially satisfies the original unskip criteria, and the issue carries protected maintainer/product-decision labels that should not be resolved by cleanup automation.

options.title: Restore one static WEBP e2e test
options.body: Add a narrow deterministic static WEBP sticker metadata test beside the active cache-refresh test and prove it on the requested CI lanes.

options.title: Accept current coverage
options.body: Document that the cache-refresh e2e test, runtime source, and docs are sufficient, then close this issue as a maintainer coverage decision.

options.title: Adopt the closed candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer the prior approach, reopen or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/68845 after refreshing it against current main and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Restore one static WEBP e2e test
recommendation.body: Add a narrow deterministic static WEBP sticker metadata test beside the active cache-refresh test and prove it on the requested CI lanes.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged stabilization PR that introduced the quarantine and this follow-up was authored by this person.
